sentences.text: The holotype, which is the specimen the species is based on, represented a subadult individual estimated to be around 4.3 meters long and 450 kilograms in mass.
The holotype specimen was collected during expeditions in 1977, 1982, and 1983 from the Cañadón Asfalto Formation.
The type species Piatnitzkysaurus floresi was described by Jose Bonaparte in 1979.
The genus name Piatnitzkysaurus was named to honor Alejandro Matveievich Piatnitzky, a Russian-born Argentine geologist.
Piatnitzkysaurus is part of the most basal clade within Megalosauroidea, which also contains Condorraptor, Marshosaurus, and Xuanhanosaurus.
It is debated whether Condorraptor is a distinct species or merely individual variation within Piatnitzkysaurus due to their strong resemblance.
